findings.finding: claimRun replays the first receipt with duplicate:false; the browser and HTTP gate dispatch whenever duplicate is false.
findings.requiredTest: Post the same request and idempotency key twice, including concurrent attempts and after service reload. The mock responder must run at most once. Reusing the key for changed chat/body must conflict.

findings.finding: recover marks every active run and claimed queue UNKNOWN without checking whether a different owner is still alive.
findings.requiredTest: Opening a second client must not recover or release an active first client's run. Abandoned work requires explicit or proven-safe recovery.

findings.finding: cancelRun enforces ownership only if options.ownerId is supplied, allowing callers to omit it.
findings.requiredTest: A second ledger owner cannot cancel the first owner's run by omitting owner fields.

findings.finding: The existing active agent runtime has an independent hardcoded model path; selector metadata alone cannot change that runtime.
findings.requiredTest: The selected provider/model/effort reaches the model factory actually invoked by the agent runtime, and response provenance uses actual response metadata.

findings.finding: Several candidate handoffs initially supplied standalone modules without reachable UI or complete runtime hooks.
findings.requiredTest: Each changed feature has an end-to-end isolated user-flow test through the supplied candidate bridge, followed by integration verification.

findings.finding: An intermediate provider hunk deleted run saveData failure handling and chatRequests registration while adding selection fields.
findings.requiredTest: Final composed request path preserves durable capture, persistence failure prevention, pending registration, Stop and final cleanup.

findings.finding: Queue schema limits all retained entries to eight while enqueue counts only active entries; completed entries exhaust storage capacity.
findings.requiredTest: More than eight sequential completed requests remain usable while the actual eight-pending limit is enforced.

findings.finding: Browser run fingerprint serializes entire chat history into a bounded field instead of the actual request window.
findings.requiredTest: Long history exceeding fingerprint limits still permits a bounded outgoing request and same-request replay remains blocked.

findings.finding: Usage coercion treats null, empty string and false as observed zero tokens.
findings.requiredTest: Unavailable or malformed usage is absent/unknown; only validated observed counts are shown.

findings.finding: Advertised effort levels collapse to the same thinking-enabled flag and non-default production adapters were not wired.
findings.requiredTest: Only confirmed supported settings are offered; each advertised configured provider has a reachable production adapter and selection-to-runtime test.

findings.finding: Minimal detail preferences did not gate active run tool output, and completed FAILURE with nonempty raw output could lose its visible failure cue.
findings.requiredTest: Active raw/investigation remains hidden by default; working, Stop, acknowledgements, failures and UNKNOWN remain visible independently of detail preferences.

findings.finding: Imported enabled schedules can dispatch on open; adapter ignored deterministic occurrence identity and created random request IDs.
findings.requiredTest: Imported jobs are disabled without altering unrelated current jobs; two clients dispatching one occurrence invoke responder at most once and uncertain work is not automatically retried.

findings.finding: Weekly next-run calculation returns today when the requested weekday differs but today's time has not passed.
findings.requiredTest: Weekly scheduling respects the selected weekday, timezone and future-time boundary; DST behavior is explicit.

findings.finding: Timestamp-only pin comparison loses legacy boolean pin ordering; appending sorted pinned DOM rows can move them below unpinned section.
findings.requiredTest: New and legacy pinned items remain in the correct section and stable order after reload; failed persistence rolls back.
